title: 1993 FPG Jeffrey Jones Fantasy Art #6 Winning Trading Card
descriptionText: The 1993 FPG Jeffrey Jones Fantasy Art Trading Card #6 Winning is a single non-sport trading card featuring fantastical artwork by illustrator Jeffery Jones. Manufactured by FPG Cards in the United States, this original card is part of the base set released in 1993. Made of card stock, this English-language card showcases the theme of fantasy and is a valuable addition to any collector's deck.
